Merge the topics of a model into fewer topics

Source: R/hierarchy.R
reduce_topics.Rd

reduce_topics() merges the closest topics of a fitted model into n_topics topics, giving a coarser model in which every document keeps its place: documents that shared a topic still share one. A model with more topics than the data support has near-duplicate topics that divide one theme between them; merging them differs from fitting a new model with fewer topics, in which documents may be regrouped.

It cuts the hierarchy of topic_hierarchy() into n_topics groups and merges the topics within each group. The new topic centers are the normalized means of their members' embeddings, and the terms, labels, sizes, representatives, and sums of squares are computed again for the merged topics. The result is a topic model like any other, so every verb applies to it. Names given with name_topics() are dropped, because the merged topics need new ones.

Usage

reduce_topics(object, n_topics, embeddings = NULL, method = "average")

Arguments

object

A topic model fitted by topics().

n_topics

Number of topics after merging: at least 2 and below the current number.

embeddings

The embedding matrix the model was fitted on. Needed only for a model fitted with keep_embeddings = FALSE. Default NULL.

method

Agglomeration method passed to stats::hclust() (default "average").

Value

A topic model of class sbert_topic_model with n_topics topics, structured as a topics() fit.

Conditions

Errors of class sbert_bad_input when n_topics is not below the current number of topics, and sbert_no_embeddings when the model holds no embeddings and none are given.

See also

topic_hierarchy() to see which topics would merge; compare_topics() to compare fits with different numbers of topics.

Examples

corpus <- head(dedupe(feedback_translations, column = "translation"), 600)
topic_model <- topics(corpus, n_topics = 6, column = "translation",
                      embeddings = feedback_embeddings)
reduced <- reduce_topics(topic_model, n_topics = 4)
topic_sizes(reduced, weights = "n")
#>   topic                                                       label n_documents
#> 1     1   Where is the cow and the cake? Choose all the pictures...         356
#> 2     2         What does “all the ones between the leaf and the...         168
#> 3     3 Are you sure you have fewer pictures in the red box than...          49
#> 4     4    It is not a person, does not have a hat, and is sitting.          27
#>   proportion n_weighted weighted_share
#> 1 0.59333333        429     0.57972973
#> 2 0.28000000        195     0.26351351
#> 3 0.08166667         76     0.10270270
#> 4 0.04500000         40     0.05405405
